description: For \(L\)-structures \(M,N\), a partial elementary map is an injective function \(f:A\to N\) on an arbitrary subset \(A\subseteq M\) such that \(M\models\varphi(\bar a)\) if and only if \(N\models\varphi(f\bar a)\) for every finite tuple \(\bar a\) from \(A\) and every \(L\)-formula in that tuple context. The domain need not be finite or a substructure.
